carousel:H0ldStillPlease:move:832438379:.h: Harrell Out at East Carolina, Takes Stanford Job Ahead of Winless Start
carousel:H0ldStillPlease:move:832438379:.d: [[c:H0ldStillPlease|Coach Harrell]] leaves [[t:832438301|East Carolina]] for [[t:832438379|Stanford]] after a 19-19 run. Pirate_flag now holds the keys in Greenville, and Harrell inherits an 0-2 team.

quote.text: He wanted a bigger stage and a fresh budget. Stanford offered both.
quote.by: a source close to the program

561119626battle.h: Ole Miss Holds Narrow Edge for Wilds, but Oklahoma Is Pressing
561119626battle.d: Five-star corner [[r:561119626|W. Wilds]] wants a title contender, and [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] has the early lead over [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]]. Texas is still in the picture despite the Syracuse upset. A source says the Sooners had him on campus.

quote.text: He's looking at who can win it all. That's the whole thing.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

561121675battle.h: Missouri Still Leads for Favre, but Michigan Is Closing Fast
561121675battle.d: [[t:832438344|Missouri]] holds the edge for [[r:561121675|I. Favre]], whose dealbreaker is conference prestige. Michigan has made up ground and Indiana lurks. Missouri's loss to Colorado won't help the Tigers.

quote.text: He likes Missouri, but the Michigan visit went really well.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

561125724battle.h: Clemson leads for Coburn, but home-state pull could swing it to Alabama
561125724battle.d: [[t:832438293|Clemson]] has the advantage for five-star [[r:561125724|P. Coburn]], but proximity to home is his dealbreaker and [[t:832438274|Alabama]] is a short drive from Coral Springs. Ole Miss is also lurking.

quote.text: His mom keeps saying she wants to see him play on Saturdays. That matters.
quote.by: a source close to the family

561121494battle.h: Georgia leads Miami for Yeast, but playing time is the wild card
561121494battle.d: [[t:832438312|Georgia]] holds the edge for five-star receiver [[r:561121494|W. Yeast]]. [[t:832438337|Miami]] has been selling an immediate role and has not backed down, and Florida State is lurking. Georgia's staff is reportedly feeling it.

quote.text: He doesn't want to wait his turn. Whoever shows him the field wins.
quote.by: a source close to the program

561120536battle.h: Notre Dame Barely Ahead for Longo as Oklahoma, Missouri Lurk
561120536battle.d: [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] holds a slim lead for five-star receiver [[r:561120536|C. Longo]], who wants brand exposure. [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]] is right there, and Missouri is lurking. Official visits could decide it.

quote.text: He loves the Notre Dame brand, but he hasn't made any promises.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

561121938battle.h: Tennessee Has the Edge for K. Simonson, but Oklahoma Isn't Backing Off
561121938battle.d: Conference prestige is the dealbreaker for [[r:561121938|K. Simonson]], and the SEC pitch is landing. Oklahoma is still in the room, and Texas Tech is lingering. One more big week could end this.

quote.text: He keeps coming back to the league. Every conversation ends up there.
quote.by: a source close to the recruitment

557727130:underpaid.h: E. Udoh Is Making Nothing, and Rival Collectives Know It
557727130:underpaid.d: [[p:557727130|E.Udoh]] is an 88-overall receiver at [[t:832438347|NC State]] earning nothing in NIL. Players at his position and rating command around 105K. That gap rarely survives portal season.

quote.text: Everybody in that market has his number. It's only a matter of who calls first.

561121140battle.h: Texas Tech Leads for Wolf, but Texas Is Closing and Aggies Lurk
561121140battle.d: [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] has the lead for five-star corner [[r:561121140|E. Wolf]], who wants playing time. [[t:832438384|Texas]] hasn't gone away, and Texas A&M is in the mix. The Fresno State loss gives rivals an opening.

quote.text: He wants to know where he can play on day one.

561119899commit.h: Stanford Lands Durante, a California Safety Who Wanted to Start
561119899commit.d: Stanford sold the three-star strong safety on a chance to compete right away. For a pass defense that has been a problem, that pitch carries weight. Durante is staying close to home, and his family played a role.

quote.text: I believe I can come in and start right away. That's what I wanted.

557718419:underpaid.h: I. Rashed Is Playing Like a Star and Getting Paid Like a Backup
557718419:underpaid.d: [[p:557718419|I.Rashed]], an 88-overall safety, makes 65K while comparable players command around 140K. Rival staffs have noticed, and the portal tends to fix numbers like that.

quote.text: You watch the tape and wonder why he isn't making double.

831914385:upset.h: No. 1 Ohio State falls to Nebraska and the bracket takes a hit
831914385:upset.d: The top-ranked team in the country lost to Nebraska despite moving the ball. Tuddy_roosevelt's team had the yards and still left with a loss. Per a source close to the program, the mood in the building afterward was ugly.

quote.text: We did everything but finish. That's what's eating guys up.
quote.by: a source close to the Ohio State program

831914385:4th:832438348.h: Nebraska's fourth-down aggression broke Ohio State in a 28-25 win
831914385:4th:832438348.d: [[t:832438348|Nebraska]] converted 3 of 4 fourth-down tries, and each one seemed to drain a little more out of the [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] defense. A Buckeyes staffer admitted the sideline went quiet after the second conversion.

quote.text: Every time they stayed out there, you could feel our guys deflate.

557719266:underpaid.h: Trueblood is a bargain at Tennessee, but rival collectives are circling
557719266:underpaid.d: [[p:557719266|L.Trueblood]] is an 89-overall guard making nothing in NIL, while players at his position and rating command around 190K. [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] has the fourth-deepest NIL pockets nationally, but rival collectives have noticed.

quote.text: A guard that good at that price won't stay quiet for long.

557719074:fit.h: Neighbors may be a bad fit in Ohio State's offense
557719074:fit.d: [[p:557719074|T.Neighbors]] is a 91-overall receiver on a team ranked 125th of 138 in receptions. After the Nebraska loss, a source says other programs are already sniffing around.

quote.text: He's a playmaker who isn't getting the ball. Guys like that start listening.
quote.by: a source close to the player

557713038:fit.h: Lyle could hit the portal if Ohio State's passing game stays stuck
557713038:fit.d: [[p:557713038|B.Lyle]], a 90-overall pocket passer, plays for an [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] offense ranked 130th of 138 in passing yards per game. The loss to Nebraska only fueled the chatter about his future.

quote.text: He wants to throw the ball. Right now that's not the offense.
quote.by: a person close to the QB room

557717760:fit.h: Blunt's future at Ohio State is murky as the run game sputters
557717760:fit.d: [[p:557717760|S.Blunt]], an 88-overall back, plays for an [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] team ranked 127th of 138 in rushing yards per game. A back who seeks contact wants carries, and the scheme isn't giving him many.

quote.text: He's built to run downhill. The offense isn't set up for it.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557718710:underpaid.h: Somebody Will Back Up the Truck for D. Boger. Is It Wake Forest?
557718710:underpaid.d: [[p:557718710|D.Boger]] is an 84-overall quarterback making 65K. Players at his position and rating command around 155K. [[t:832438407|Wake Forest]] has been mentioned as a landing spot, and others will surely make calls.

quote.text: Quarterbacks with that rating don't stay cheap for long.

831914108:upset.h: Syracuse stuns Texas, and rival recruiters smell blood
831914108:upset.d: The Longhorns were ranked 16th and got outgained and outmuscled at home by [[t:832438380|Syracuse]]. Rival staffs chasing Texas targets are already working the phones, per a source.

quote.text: You can't sell 'national contender' the week after that tape goes around.
quote.by: an assistant at a rival program

831914715:int:557725897.h: A.Renda's six-interception disaster leaves Mississippi State searching for answers
831914715:int:557725897.d: [[p:557725897|A.Renda]] kept throwing into traffic and [[t:832438381|TCU]] kept collecting. Teammates were short on words afterward, and the quarterback room may not stay quiet for long, a source said.

quote.text: He kept trying to make one big play. We needed him to take the easy one.
quote.by: a source close to the Mississippi State program

831914025:4th:832438287.h: Buffalo's fourth-down obsession burns it, and the fan base is livid
831914025:4th:832438287.d: [[t:832438287|Buffalo]] kept the offense on the field and kept coming up empty against [[t:832438370|Rutgers]]. Boosters are grumbling that the staff trusted the chalkboard over its own kicker.

quote.text: Take the points once in a while. Nobody gets fired for taking the points.

831914108:int:557713620.h: R.Crum's three picks put Texas's quarterback spot under the microscope
831914108:int:557713620.d: [[p:557713620|R.Crum]] gave the ball away three times in the upset loss to [[t:832438380|Syracuse]]. Sources say the staff will spend the week deciding how much patience is left.

quote.text: Nobody in that building is pointing fingers, but everybody saw the tape.
quote.by: a source close to the Texas program

831914715:pass:557716196.h: L.Connors turns Mississippi State's secondary into target practice
831914715:pass:557716196.d: [[p:557716196|L.Connors]] threw for six touchdowns as [[t:832438381|TCU]] rolled to a 61-14 win over [[t:832438343|Mississippi State]]. NFL-minded scouts in the press box were taking notes.

831914452:comeback.h: Coastal Carolina storms back in the fourth against an FCS Midwest foe
831914452:comeback.d: [[t:832438294|Coastal Carolina]] trailed 27-13 entering the final quarter, then won it 17-0. The sideline got loud, and a halftime message apparently didn't land until the third quarter ended.

quote.text: We stopped waiting for something to happen and made it happen.

831914792:comeback.h: West Virginia erases a fourth-quarter hole to beat NC State in a 52-49 thriller
831914792:comeback.d: [[t:832438410|West Virginia]] trailed 41-28 after three quarters and won the last one 24-8. [[t:832438347|NC State]] let it slip, and its coaches may spend the week fielding questions about the closing defense.

quote.text: That's a locker room that does not quit. Period.
quote.by: a source close to the West Virginia program

831914030:comeback.h: Wyoming rallies past UTEP after trailing entering the fourth
831914030:comeback.d: [[t:832438414|Wyoming]] trailed 35-24 after three and outscored [[t:832438402|UTEP]] 17-3 down the stretch. The defense found itself late, and the sideline credited a halftime adjustment.

831914737:comeback.h: New Mexico State shuts out an FCS East team in the fourth to steal it
831914737:comeback.d: [[t:832438351|New Mexico State]] trailed 21-10 after three quarters and won the fourth 21-0. A booster at the game said the energy in the stadium flipped when the defense got a stop.

quote.text: You could feel it change. Nobody wanted to be the one who blinked.

831914203:4th:832438363.h: Ole Miss refuses to punt, converts every fourth down in 52-13 rout
831914203:4th:832438363.d: [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] went 4-for-4 on fourth down against [[t:832438365|Oregon State]], a statement that can't hurt with elite recruits watching. Word is the staff sold that aggression on visits this week.

quote.text: That's the program we're building. We play to win.
quote.by: a source close to the Ole Miss program

831914784:4th:832438406.h: Virginia Tech's fourth-down math doesn't survive contact with Arizona
831914784:4th:832438406.d: [[t:832438406|Virginia Tech]] turned it over on downs three times in the loss to [[t:832438276|Arizona]]. The numbers crowd will argue it was right, but the fan base has stopped listening.

quote.text: It's fine until it fails, and it failed three times.

831914312:rush:557716795.h: Stockton scores four times and gives Penn State's run game a lift
831914312:rush:557716795.d: [[p:557716795|I.Stockton]] ran through contact all afternoon, breaking seven tackles on the way to four touchdowns. That helps agerm40 answer the rushing questions, and it will make Stockton's name pop up on rival staffs' radar.

quote.text: He runs angry. Once he starts, you can't tackle him with one guy.

831914593:pass:557712048.h: J.Landry throws for 411 yards and still loses to Texas Tech
831914593:pass:557712048.d: [[p:557712048|J.Landry]] did everything he could, but [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] escaped 35-33. Texas Tech's staff will take the win, and Landry's team will wonder how a monster day ended in a loss.

quote.text: We left too many points out there. That's on all of us.

831914117:def:557724765.h: K.Hayward's three interceptions power Iowa's 49-19 win over Florida Atlantic
831914117:def:557724765.d: [[p:557724765|K.Hayward]] grabbed three passes against [[t:832438309|Florida Atlantic]], making him the player opposing offensive coordinators will be talking about this week.

831914718:ot.h: Sacramento State survives an overtime scare, 21-14
831914718:ot.d: [[t:832438371|Sacramento State]] needed the extra period to beat an FCS West opponent, taking overtime 7-0. A source said the postgame locker room was more relief than celebration.

831914440:flags:832438281.h: Auburn's ten penalties hand Miami the game
831914440:flags:832438281.d: [[t:832438281|Auburn]] kept shooting itself in the foot against [[t:832438337|Miami]], and the coaches weren't happy. Expect a punishing week of practice for the Tigers.

quote.text: Practice is going to be a lot less fun this week.

831914673:flags:832438357.h: Notre Dame's ten penalties leave a bad look against Indiana
831914673:flags:832438357.d: [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] lost its composure and the loss to [[t:832438319|Indiana]] followed. A prime-time stage was supposed to help the Irish pitch recruits, and instead rival staffs are already using the tape.

quote.text: That's the kind of film other programs love to show a recruit.

831914408:rec:557727821.h: D.Melton can't be stopped, torches Central Michigan for four scores
831914408:rec:557727821.d: [[p:557727821|D.Melton]] saw bracket coverage and made it irrelevant. Bigger programs are expected to check on his situation, per a source.

quote.text: He's a different tier. You can't scheme him out of a game.

831914210:int:557717973.h: J.Daly throws three picks, but San Jose State escapes UTSA
831914210:int:557717973.d: [[p:557717973|J.Daly]] threw for two touchdowns and three interceptions in a shaky win over [[t:832438403|UTSA]]. His coach was reportedly not thrilled with the decision-making in the second half.

quote.text: We won, but he knows he has to be cleaner.
quote.by: a source close to the San Jose State program

831914905:shutout.h: Minnesota blanks an FCS East opponent, 17-0, and the offense never got a first down
831914905:shutout.d: [[t:832438342|Minnesota]] didn't just win, it made the opposition's afternoon a disaster. The defense dominated from the first series, per a source.

831914701:def:557724775.h: D.Tuman wrecks UAB's opponent with three sacks in a 38-14 win
831914701:def:557724775.d: [[p:557724775|D.Tuman]] lived in the backfield all game. Scouts were already comparing his burst to an NFL edge rusher, a source said.

quote.text: Every time I looked up, 94 was already there.

831914582:def:557717959.h: K.Huntley picks off Washington State twice in a loss
831914582:def:557717959.d: [[p:557717959|K.Huntley]] played a monster game that his team couldn't turn into a win against [[t:832438409|Washington State]]. His teammates were frustrated that the defense did everything but win.

quote.text: I did my job. That doesn't help if we lose.

831914860:3rd:832438356.h: Northwestern can't move the chains and loses to Texas A&M
831914860:3rd:832438356.d: [[t:832438356|Northwestern]] went 2-for-13 on third down, and the play-calling is going to take heat. A source said some players were unhappy with the plan.

quote.text: We kept running into the same wall. Nothing changed.

831914216:blowout.h: Baylor flattens an FCS West opponent, 51-7
831914216:blowout.d: [[t:832438283|Baylor]] piled up 532 yards and let the starters watch the end. The Bears' coach was reportedly happy with the effort.

831914773:blowout.d: [[t:832438393|UCF]] gained 553 yards and had the game decided early. [[t:832438326|Kennesaw State]] will be looking for answers on defense.

831914885:blowout.h: Virginia drops 59 on an FCS West opponent, winning 59-10
831914885:blowout.d: [[t:832438405|Virginia]] rolled up 520 yards and looked like the better team from the opening drive. Staffers said they liked the tempo.

quote.text: That's what a statement looks like.

831914614:rec:557723324.h: G.Heeney leaves USF's secondary chasing shadows with three touchdowns
831914614:rec:557723324.d: [[p:557723324|G.Heeney]] caught seven passes and scored three times against [[t:832438399|USF]]. The USF cornerbacks are still looking for answers.

quote.text: He was open every time we blinked.

831914829:rec:557726535.h: M.Vitti scores three times as bracket coverage fails against an FCS East team
831914829:rec:557726535.d: [[p:557726535|M.Vitti]] caught seven passes and made every defensive adjustment look useless. Sources said opponents were already game-planning around him.

831914776:upset.h: Boise State Survives Arizona State by a Single Point in Poll-Shaking Upset
831914776:upset.d: No. 25 [[t:832438284|Boise State]] edged No. 23 [[t:832438277|Arizona State]], 28-27, and the Sun Devils left feeling they gave it away. A slide in the rankings is coming, and a few Arizona State boosters are already grumbling.

quote.text: We play to the whistle. They felt it late.

831914302:4th:832438379.h: Harrell's Four Fourth-Down Gambles Sink Stanford and Enrage the Boards
831914302:4th:832438379.d: [[t:832438379|Stanford]] kept the offense on the field against [[t:832438356|Northwestern]] and turned it over on downs three times. The fan base is losing patience with the new coach. Some inside the building wonder if he trusts his defense at all.

quote.text: I trusted my guys. We came up short.

831914196:comeback.h: UTEP Blows a Three-Score Lead as Western Kentucky Storms Back in Overtime
831914196:comeback.d: [[t:832438411|Western Kentucky]] won the fourth quarter 21-0 and the extra period too, stunning [[t:832438402|UTEP]], 48-42. A source says the UTEP locker room was silent afterward.

quote.text: Nobody in that room said a word. You could hear the shower drip.
quote.by: a source close to the UTEP program

831914166:int:557725326.h: Marriott's Four Interceptions Leave USC's Quarterback Room Under a Microscope
831914166:int:557725326.d: [[p:557725326|R.Marriott]] threw four picks and no touchdowns as [[t:832438398|USC]] fell to [[t:832438380|Syracuse]]. Trojans staffers say the coaches stood by him on the sideline. Boosters are asking questions anyway.

quote.text: He's our guy. One bad day doesn't change that.

831914227:upset.h: Colorado Stuns No. 12 Missouri 19-17, and Columbia Gets Restless
831914227:upset.d: [[t:832438295|Colorado]] forced three turnovers and held on to knock off [[t:832438344|Missouri]]. The Tigers will drop in the polls, and the loss could make recruits like I. Favre and C. Longo pause.

quote.text: That one stings. We got outworked in the details.

831914832:flags:832438349.h: Nevada's Eleven Penalties Hand Ohio State a Gift Win
831914832:flags:832438349.d: [[t:832438349|Nevada]] was flagged 11 times for 95 yards against [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]. Tuddy_roosevelt got his bounce-back, but a source says the Buckeyes' staff still sees things to clean up.

quote.text: We got the win, but we're not satisfied with the product.
quote.by: a source close to the Ohio State program

831914166:ot.h: Syracuse Edges USC in Overtime, 33-27, and Keeps Stacking Big Wins
831914166:ot.d: [[t:832438380|Syracuse]] took the extra period 6-0 and won an ugly one. After last week's upset of Texas, the Orange are suddenly a team no one wants to see. USC is left with an even longer plane ride.

quote.text: Nobody believed in us. That's fine. We believed.

831914237:4th:832438321.h: Iowa State's Fourth-Down Aggression Backfires Against Iowa
831914237:4th:832438321.d: [[t:832438321|Iowa State]] went for it four times, converted two, and turned it over on downs twice. The coach's defenders cite the math. Fans in Ames don't care. Social media is not kind.

quote.text: Analytics don't win in-state rivalry games. Points do.

831914483:pass:557723567.h: Griggs Throws Five Touchdowns as Washington Outruns Tennessee 48-34
831914483:pass:557723567.d: [[p:557723567|L.Griggs]] threw for 328 yards and five scores in a win over [[t:832438383|Tennessee]]. Scouts are noticing. A rival defensive coordinator reportedly called the Husky offense a nightmare to prepare for.

quote.text: Griggs saw everything before the snap. We never got a hand on him.

831914573:int:557718221.h: Ole Miss Defense Turns Yoder's Day Into a Turnover Clinic
831914573:int:557718221.d: [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] picked off [[p:557718221|T.Yoder]] four times, and every throw seemed to land in the wrong hands. The secondary feasted. The defense's showing is a strong pitch for W. Wilds, who wants a title contender.

quote.text: Our DBs were baiting him all day. We knew where the ball was going.

831914041:int:557727686.h: Mississippi State Thrives as Holloway's Three Picks Doom Tulane
831914041:int:557727686.d: [[p:557727686|B.Holloway]] threw three interceptions as [[t:832438390|Tulane]] lost to [[t:832438343|Mississippi State]]. The Bulldogs' defense bailed out a quarterback who threw six picks last week, and A. Renda's job feels safer for now.

quote.text: The defense gave us a gift. We took it.

831914703:int:557725879.h: Waggoner's Three Interceptions Doom Baylor Against BYU
831914703:int:557725879.d: [[p:557725879|R.Waggoner]] had a nightmare afternoon as [[t:832438283|Baylor]] fell to [[t:832438288|BYU]]. The Bears' staff had no answer. A source says the quarterback stayed on the field long after the stadium emptied.

quote.text: He was out there throwing alone, staring at nothing.
quote.by: a source close to the Baylor program

831914466:4th:832438351.h: New Mexico State's Fourth-Down Gambles Backfire in Sam Houston Loss
831914466:4th:832438351.d: [[t:832438351|New Mexico State]] went 1-for-4 on fourth down against [[t:832438372|Sam Houston]] and turned it over on downs three times. The punter barely saw the field. Gutsy, sure. Smart, not so much.

quote.text: We believe in our offense. Sometimes belief gets you burned.

831914342:blowout.h: Penn State Piles Up 627 Yards in Rout of FCS Southeast
831914342:blowout.d: [[t:832438366|Penn State]] ran FCS Southeast out of the building, 52-10, and agerm40's offense looked unstoppable. I. Stockton's running continues to draw looks from bigger programs. A rival scout said the Lions could score at will.

quote.text: They got every yard they wanted. It was a clinic.

831914804:shutout.h: Texas A&M Pitches 34-0 Shutout; FCS Northwest Never Gets Moving
831914804:shutout.d: [[t:832438385|Texas A&M]] held FCS Northwest without a yard or a first down. The defense was dominant, though a staffer cautioned that the real tests are ahead. The Aggies appreciated the tune-up.

quote.text: Not a single yard. That's the standard.

831914574:pass:557723721.h: Beaver Carves Up Overmatched Opponent for 460 Yards in LSU Rout
831914574:pass:557723721.d: [[p:557723721|B.Beaver]] completed 31 of 38 passes without an interception as LSU won 56-17. Scouts say he looks every bit like a first-round arm. The defense could only watch.

quote.text: I've seen quarterbacks get hot, but this was surgical.

831914444:pass:557717471.h: Harris Torches Opponent as Louisiana Cruises to 45-6 Win
831914444:pass:557717471.d: [[p:557717471|P.Harris]] threw for 317 yards and five touchdowns in a blowout win. Sources say the Ragin' Cajuns coaches told him to enjoy it, then sent him to the film room.

quote.text: Everyone in the room felt it. He was in control.

831914491:rivalry.h: Pittsburgh Wins Another Backyard Brawl That Came Down to the Wire
831914491:rivalry.d: [[t:832438367|Pittsburgh]] got the final stop and the final word in a rivalry that never fails to deliver. Sources in the Steel City say the locker room was loud, and the coach walked off with a grin.

quote.text: You live for this one. Every year, it comes down to the last snap.

831914134:blowout.h: TCU Rolls Up 609 Yards in No-Mercy Blowout of Air Force
831914134:blowout.d: [[t:832438381|TCU]] hung 48 on [[t:832438272|Air Force]] in a game that was never close. The Falcons' option attack never got started. A source said the Air Force sideline went quiet early.

quote.text: We got outmuscled. It was that simple.
quote.by: a source close to the Air Force program

831914253:shutout.h: Auburn Blanks Liberty 51-0 and Makes It Look Easy
831914253:shutout.d: [[t:832438281|Auburn]] limited [[t:832438329|Liberty]] to 180 yards and 7 first downs. The Tigers' defense has bounced back from a loss to Miami, and the staff won't say it, but this one felt good.

quote.text: We needed this. Everyone in the building knew it.

831914645:def:557717838.h: Levine Camps Out in Opponent's Backfield with Three Sacks in Michigan Win
831914645:def:557717838.d: [[p:557717838|R.Levine]] had five tackles, three for loss, in Michigan's 49-21 win. Opposing tackles couldn't stop him. Scouts say he's the most disruptive edge in the league.

quote.text: You can't block him one-on-one. Nobody can.

831914627:def:557726041.h: Sanders Picks Off Kansas Twice as Virginia Wins 34-24
831914627:def:557726041.d: [[p:557726041|T.Sanders]] read the quarterback's eyes all day against [[t:832438324|Kansas]]. The Hoos' defensive coordinator was seen smiling on the sideline.

quote.text: He baited the throw and jumped it. Textbook.

831914105:flags:832438387.h: Texas Tech's Twelve Penalties Sink the Red Raiders Against Fresno State
831914105:flags:832438387.d: [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] was flagged 12 times for 86 yards in a loss to [[t:832438311|Fresno State]]. The sloppy day couldn't come at a worse time with E. Wolf deciding. Rivals are circling.

quote.text: Discipline wins games. It wasn't there Saturday.
quote.by: a source close to the Texas Tech program

831914725:3rd:832438375.h: SMU Goes 2-for-13 on Third Down in Loss to Wake Forest
831914725:3rd:832438375.d: [[t:832438375|SMU]] couldn't stay on the field in a loss to [[t:832438407|Wake Forest]]. B. Bouye, the NIL target many expect to land with the Mustangs, will not love this tape.

quote.text: We can't win like that. Every drive died on the money down.

831914560:rec:557718616.h: Babers Torches Washington State for 135 Yards and Three Touchdowns
831914560:rec:557718616.d: [[p:557718616|G.Babers]] caught four passes, including a 60-yarder, to dominate [[t:832438409|Washington State]]. The Cougars' secondary had no answer, and NFL scouts are asking questions.

quote.text: He's a cheat code. You cannot cover him one-on-one.

561124002battle.h: Notre Dame Leads for Five-Star C. Faulkner, but Clemson Won't Fold
561124002battle.d: [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] has the lead for [[r:561124002|C. Faulkner]], but he has made playing time his dealbreaker. [[t:832438293|Clemson]] keeps pushing, and Michigan is lurking. The Irish depth chart will be part of this.

quote.text: He wants to know when he's on the field, not when he's going to be on it.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557711446:buried.h: T. Gayton Is Too Good to Sit. Is a Transfer Coming?
557711446:buried.d: [[p:557711446|T.Gayton]], an 82-overall sophomore punter, has taken no snaps in 3 games. Programs in the portal market would start him tomorrow, and he knows it.

quote.text: A punter that good should be punting. Someone out there needs one.
quote.by: a special teams coordinator at a rival program

557715137:buried.h: Stuck at No. 3 at Notre Dame, J. Pyke Might Not Wait Around
557715137:buried.d: [[p:557715137|J.Pyke]] is an 83-overall junior guard with no snaps in 3 games, and he sits No. 3 on the [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] depth chart. The portal market would start him tomorrow, and the wait is wearing on him.

quote.text: He's a guy who needs to play, and right now he isn't.
quote.by: a source close to the player

557713073:buried.h: H. Wonnum Is Too Good to Sit. Is a Transfer Coming?
557713073:buried.d: [[p:557713073|H.Wonnum]], an 83-overall sophomore middle linebacker, has played 11 snaps in 3 games. Rival programs would start him immediately, and his camp is aware of that.

quote.text: He's not complaining, but he's definitely noticing who's out there ahead of him.
quote.by: a person close to the player
